fields.name: query
fields.note: The species or taxon to resolve. Can be a common name ('ashwagandha'), scientific name ('Withania somnifera'), or partial name. The resolver identifies the canonical taxon, GBIF key, and phylogenetic position.

fields.name: include_genome
fields.note: Optional. If true, include genome assembly data (chromosome count, estimated size, notable genes) when available from NCBI. Default false.

fields.name: include_conservation
fields.note: Optional. If true, include IUCN conservation status and population trend. Default false.
